english.title: Use rebated heavy oil in deliberate contravention of a restriction in the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent that the restrictions imposed by section 12 of the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979 should be contravened, used heavy oil in contravention of section 12(2) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(3)(a), (5) and (6) of the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Any heavy oil:-
(a) taken into a road vehicle as mentioned in section 12(2) or supplied as mentioned in section 13(2) or (3) or
(b) taken as fuel into a vehicle at a time when it is not a road vehicle and remaining in the vehicle as part of its fuel supply at a later time when it becomes a road vehicle,
shall be liable to forfeiture.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of £20,000 or of three times the value of the oil in question, whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for Prosecutions:
None
